releaseNotes: HWM 0.2.5.7 PILOT promotion using the exact successful DEV build. This release is URGENT so PILOT clients can install when they next check in without waiting for the maintenance window. Service 0.2.5.6 starts the isolated HWM Terminal command poll loop immediately when the Windows service starts instead of waiting behind the full health scan and first normal cloud cycle. Terminal polling is reduced from 15 seconds to 5 seconds. Terminal authentication, one-shot execution, expiry, output limits, auditing, Mesh recovery, tray 1.0.0.6 and Managed Updater 0.1.3.0 are unchanged.
